title: Mark Winters & Roxé deliver a reminder that love lives in the details with "Find My Love - Acoustic Me"
htmlContent: In his newest release, "Find My Love - Acoustic Me", singer-songwriter Mark Winters strips things down to the essentials, and what's left is a track so tender, it feels like a shared secret. Featuring the rich, soulful vocals of Roxé, this acoustic version is a reimagining of the original and a cozy, melodic conversation about love's quiet magic. Winters, who masterfully balances both poetic charm and scientific precision in his writing, doesn't chase the flashy. Instead, he leans into the beautiful ordinary, the delicate surprise of a flower tucked behind an ear, or the way coffee shared in silence says more than a thousand texts. It's those subtle moments that make "Find My Love - Acoustic Me" feel like a soft spotlight on the stuff real love is made of. Roxé's contribution elevates the song without overpowering it. Her vocals weave gently around Winters' own, adding texture and warmth, like harmony between two people who just get each other. The chemistry is organic. Just two voices painting a picture that's deeply familiar and quietly profound. The acoustic arrangement keeps things grounded and intimate, giving the lyrics space to breathe. It feels tailor-made for your morning playlist or those in-between moments when you need a little emotional reset. https://open.spotify.com/track/2YH702KxTvfhrxL1cXtWbr It's like the sun coming through your kitchen window, your favorite mug in hand, and this song humming softly in the background. "Find My Love - Acoustic Me" is less about sweeping declarations and more about the whispering details. It's a love letter to the unnoticed, a soft nudge to look up from your phone and notice the magic sitting across the table. Mark Winters continues to remind us that sometimes, the smallest notes carry the most meaning, and that love, in all its simplicity, can still make your heart skip a beat.
excerpt: Mark Winters & Roxé deliver an intimate reminder that love resides in the little details with their acoustic single, “Find My Love - Acoustic Me.”
